# Ski Trip Skill

This skill plans a ski day or weekend from the resort, the drive, and the budget. Give the dates, the group size and levels, and the budget, and get a resort pick, a lift pass and rental plan, a packing list, and a cost split per person. It turns scattered options into one trip the group can agree on.
